player_prompt.intro:
Welkam long Frozen Lake!

Yu rippresen olsem 'P' long grid.
Simbol ol i stap long grid:
  ' ' = Frozen saface (yu ken wokabaut long em)
  'H' = Hol (yu pikinini i go daun na yu lus!
  'G' = Gol (yu ritchim des na yu win!
  'P' = Ples bilong yu nau

Aksion ol i stap: ap, daun, left, rait (o w, a, s, d)
Yu raitim aksion olsem: [up], [down], [left], [right] o [w], [a], [s], [d]

Objektib: Yu wokabaut from stat (top-left) go long gol (bottom-right) na yu no go insait long eni hol!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format bilong aksion i no gut. Yu usim [up], [down], [left], [right] o [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Aksion '{action}' i no klia. Yu usim ap, daun, left, rait, o w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Yu tryim mosim {action} tasol yu kamapak long wal!

outcome.win: Mi tok amamas long yu, nau yu winim mak!
outcome.fell_in_hole: Yu pundaun long hul! Gems pinis. Yu pinisim {pct}% bilong raun i go inapim mak.
outcome.turn_limit: Yu kamap long mak bilong tanim! Gems pinis. Yu pinisim {pct}% bilong raun i go inapim mak.
